Harbor Lane Logistics and Quill Data Systems
Quill Data Systems will operate the shipment tracking platform for Harbor Lane Logistics, including hosting, monitoring and on-call support.
The platform covers the following services:
Real-time parcel tracking for up to 40,000 shipments a day.
Monthly capacity reports delivered by the fifth business day.
A customer portal available in English and Spanish.
The platform must be available 99.9% of each calendar month, measured at the public status page.

Planned maintenance windows:	Sundays 02:00–04:00 UTC
announced 7 days ahead.
Harbor Lane Logistics will pay a fixed monthly fee of EUR 18,500, invoiced on the first day of each month and due within 30 days.
Service credits: 5% of the monthly fee for each full 0.1% below the availability target,
capped at 25% of that month's fee. Credits are the sole remedy for downtime.
This agreement starts on 1 March 2027 and runs for an initial term of 36 months.
Either party may end the agreement with 90 days' written notice after the first 12 months. Notices go to legal@harborlane.example.
Termination does not affect fees already due.
Shipment data is stored in the EU (Frankfurt region) and deleted within 60 days after the agreement ends, unless the law requires longer retention.
Signed for Harbor Lane Logistics:	Mara Ellison, Chief Operating Officer
